components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped and the result must hold 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The
            stored and returned value is that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted
            it defaults to the server's current date. Always returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is
                the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at registration.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'F.G.'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

          minimum: 0

## Summary

I implemented the household-duplicate rule for owner creation. When creating an owner via `POST /api/owners`, the request is now rejected with **409 Conflict** if another owner already has the same last name **and** the same address (compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace) — unless the request sets `sharesHousehold: true`.

Changes, each kept in its proper layer:

- **`openapi.yml`** — Added an optional `sharesHousehold` boolean (default `false`) to the `OwnerFields` schema, so the generated DTO carries the create-time opt-in flag. This reuses the existing shared schema the codebase already uses for owner create/update.
- **`DuplicateHouseholdException`** (new, `rest/error`) — Mirrors the existing `DuplicateTelephoneException`; carries the conflicting last name and address.
- **`HouseholdDuplicateValidator`** (new, `rest/validation`) — A small, single-responsibility component that normalizes (trim → collapse whitespace → lower-case) both fields, short-circuits when `sharesHousehold` is true, and throws the exception when a match exists. Data access is delegated to `ClinicService` rather than duplicated.
- **`OwnerRestControllerV1`** — Injects the new validator and invokes it in `addOwner`, alongside the existing `ownerRequestValidator` — keeping the controller thin.
- **`ExceptionControllerAdvice`** — Added a handler mapping `DuplicateHouseholdException` → 409, following the `DuplicateTelephoneException` handler's exact shape (`errors: ["lastName", "address"]`).
- **`OwnerMapper`** — Marked `sharesHousehold` as ignored on `toOwnerDto`, since it's a request-only directive the `Owner` entity doesn't store (avoids an unmapped-target warning).

Test results: `Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` — `coreRejectsSameLastNameAndAddress`, `functionalityAllowsDifferentAddress`, and `functionalityAllowsWithSharesHousehold` all green.

Note on a deliberate design choice: the validator fetches candidates via `findAllOwners()` rather than the existing prefix-based `findByLastName` query. The spec requires *case-insensitive* last-name matching, but the repository's `LIKE :lastName%` is case-sensitive under H2/HSQLDB, so a prefix query would miss case-varying names. Whitespace-collapse also can't be expressed in SQL, so post-filtering in Java is required regardless. For this app's scale that's a fine trade for guaranteed correctness, and it avoids adding a new method to all three repository implementations.
